rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for giving the reason something happened.

example.english: I’m not going shopping today because of the rain.
example.traditional: 我今日唔去行街，因為落雨。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 m4 heoi3 haang4 gaai1 jan1 wai6 lok6 jyu5

rows.note: Choose this mainly in formal or written contexts rather than casual conversation.

example.english: The flight was cancelled today because of the bad weather.
example.traditional: 由於天氣惡劣，航班今日取消。
example.jyutping: jau4 jyu1 tin1 hei3 ok3 lyut6 hong4 baan1 gam1 jat6 ceoi2 siu1
